# Callouts: Flash backup 3/5 - the LaunchPad wired for the clip read, reset held the cooker's way

Source: Own photos, raptox's LaunchPad, stitched from photos 04-08 of 2026-11-05 (jumpers as delivered in the photo)  
Annotated image: [images/annotated/fb5-1_launchpad-clip-hold.jpg](../../../images/annotated/fb5-1_launchpad-clip-hold.jpg)

The clip on U8 (no VCC lead), the reader's GND at J22. J9 on, the RST cap off, a hold lead from R321's chip-side pad to GND, J13 on SOP2. The USB goes in last: it powers the board.
